code: fuzzer receives raw TGA bytes as input
note: Attacker-controlled TGA file bytes enter the fuzzer and are passed to the TGA image handler.
The 18-byte TGA header is parsed; image_type=10 (RLE_RGB), width=1, height=1, pixel_size=24.
Header passes IsSupported checks and LoadTGA is invoked with the RLE_RGB image type.
info.rle is set true because image_type is TGA_TYPE_RLE_RGB, so the RLE decode branch is entered.
size = 1*1*3 = 3 bytes; image buffer of 3 bytes is allocated via malloc (uninitialized).
RLE packet header byte 0x00 is read; high bit clear means raw pixel packet with count = (0x00 & 0x7f) + 1 = 1.
readRawData is asked for 3 bytes but only 1 byte remains in the stream, so only 1 byte is written to the malloc'd image buffer and the remaining 2 bytes stay uninitialized.
The uninitialized bytes from the malloc'd image buffer are read to compute the RGB pixel value, triggering the use-of-uninitialized-value in MSAN.
